question: Where should the salutation to the noose be placed on the hand?
premises: The formula 'obeisance to the noose' is given.
Placement is to be performed in this manner.
The specified location is the upper left of the hand.
inference: The salutation to the noose should be placed on the upper left part of the hand.
plain_english: Saying 'obeisance to the noose,' one should place it thus on the upper left part of the hand.
